overall_status: conditional_acquired_certificate_derived; no physical validation or priority claim

claims.exact_statement: For a stationary unknown coefficient theta in a channel with predictable intensity theta*h_t and known integrated exposure A_t=integral_0^t h_u du, the Gamma(a,b)-mixture likelihood ratio M_t(theta)=b^a Gamma(a+N_t)/(Gamma(a)(b+A_t)^(a+N_t))*theta^(-N_t)*exp(theta*A_t) is a nonnegative mean-one martingale under candidate theta. For P channels, the confidence sets {theta in [0,K_j]: M_{j,t}(theta)<P/delta} simultaneously cover all true coefficients at all assay times with probability at least 1-delta, provided every true rate lies in its justified cap and the channel/exposure model is correct.
assumptions: Each channel has a stationary per-mode coefficient during calibration; the mode may be selected predictably from prior observations.
The event channel is correctly labeled and has counting-process intensity theta*h_t with known nonnegative predictable h_t.
The physical cap K_j is supplied and valid for every true coefficient.
Observed counts are complete; exposure covariates and state are measured without unmodeled error.
claims.novelty_boundary: Gamma-mixture martingales, Ville's inequality, and time-uniform confidence sequences are standard. No novelty claim is made for the statistical method.
claims.falsifier: A counting-process model mismatch, time-varying coefficient outside the finite mode parameterization, missing events, or an invalid supplied cap invalidates this acquisition guarantee.
claims.costs: Requires event counts, integrated known exposures, instrument calibration, labeled channels, and time/energy to excite each channel; zero exposure cannot certify a positive lower rate.

claims.exact_statement: For the fixed finite-volume reciprocal graph model in PROOF.md, if pilot confidence-interval endpoints give positive worst-case reaction collar margins in every operating mode after subtracting C_{i,s}*ell_q/alpha_i for symmetric exchange, then the finite-volume exponential-supermartingale exit bound applies uniformly to every predictable switch among the certified finite modes. With probability at least 1-delta over calibration, the acquired intervals cover all coefficients. If deployment is gated on the data-dependent operational bound epsilon_op(T;D)<=epsilon_target, the joint probability of calibration coverage failure or exit by T is at most delta+epsilon_target.
assumptions: The reaction jumps are integer-valued and local copy numbers Z are integer-valued.
The factorial mass-action propensity and reciprocal finite-volume hopping law in PROOF.md are valid.
Per-mode coefficients are stationary; each is inside its confidence interval on the calibration coverage event.
The graph, stoichiometry, box, collar widths, site volumes, known initial gaps, and finite mode set are supplied.
Every effective collar margin is strictly positive and all constants in PROOF.md use conservative acquired upper endpoints.
prior_art: Supplied N35 well-mixed finite-volume jump-safety proof: work/agents/systems_metabolism/chemostat_control/astra/jump_safety.txt
Howard et al. (2021), DOI 10.1214/20-AOS1991, for time-uniform confidence sequences
Agazzi, Dembo, and Eckmann (2018), DOI 10.1214/17-AAP1344, for large-volume jump-process exit asymptotics
claims.novelty_boundary: The work composes standard rate confidence sequences, endpoint monotonicity, and an internally reconstructed box/reciprocal heterogeneous-volume extension of N35. Priority is unknown. It does not use or prove N33, and makes no permanence claim.
claims.falsifier: Any nonpositive face margin, nonreciprocal transport, invalid propensity exposure, coefficient drift outside the mode model, or observed model mismatch blocks the certificate. Eventual exit remains possible in irreducible finite chains.
claims.costs: Calibration event/exposure counts, physical preparation and reset, concentration mapping, channel classification, feedstock, drive, waste, and controller implementation are application-specific. Model activity bounds V*Lambda*T and can make direct simulation infeasible.

claims.exact_statement: The runnable checker computes Gamma-mixture rate intervals, rectangular worst-case box-face margins, and reciprocal transport collar losses for a supplied finite model. Three arithmetic tests pass, including endpoint e-value equality and failure to infer a positive rate from zero exposure.
claims.limitations: The script does not test martingale coverage, the stochastic safety theorem, physical rate-law validity, transport reciprocity, or material performance.
